reviewer: Antigravity Motion Graphics Agent (verified against full HyperFrames MP4 render and snapshot contact sheets)

criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Every beat pairs a clean header with one prominent hero element: rising mobile app in Scene 1, liquidation gauge in Scene 2, 90% retail depth collapse in Scene 3, and -$2.4T takeaway monument in Scene 4.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Oswald display headers, Inter body text, and IBM Plex Mono for financial telemetry and live metric counters. All labels respect safe areas and size floors.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Engineered natively for 720x1280 portrait 9:16 mobile reels. Progress HUD is clear of top status bars (128px inset), captions sit above the 256px bottom safe zone.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Synchronized to millisecond-accurate Kokoro TTS narration cues. Multi-beat micro-choreography ensures visual updates every 2-3s without any visual stalls.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Obsidian text (#111827) and rich contrast accents achieve > 15:1 contrast against the warm off-white canvas (#FBFBFA). Crisp white cards provide clean isolation.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Warm editorial-light aesthetic with vibrant, high-contrast colors (vermilion panic #E11D48, marigold amber #F59E0B, emerald bull #059669, ultramarine blue #1D4ED8).

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Seamless, sonically transparent cuts (zero transition whooshes) matching narration scene boundaries.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Consistent financial interface and data visualization language throughout: candlestick chart, debt drawer, radial liquidation gauge, order-book depth bars, and monument stat.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Every tween directly visualizes economic mechanics: leverage multiplication, equity depletion under margin calls, order book vacuum, and state bailout shatter.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Zero static freezes during narration. Screen evolves continuously across 3-5 micro-beats per scene (demographic pops, debt bar expand, push alert cascade, particles stream, counter roll).

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Vertical layout tiers prevent collisions: top HUD, upper headline group, central viewport, and bottom captions/cards.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Dramatic four-act psychological arc: Euphoria -> The Trap Snaps -> The Human Stampede -> The Broken Spell, concluding on a 1.9s held -$2.4T monument card.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
